===================================================================
--- /root/repos/pre-commit/tests/git_test.py
+++ /root/repos/pre-commit/tests/git_test.py
@@ -140,27 +140,16 @@
     ret = set(git.get_conflicted_files())
     assert ret == {'conflict_file'}
 
 
-def test_get_conflicted_files_tracked_file_named_like_ref(in_merge_conflict):
-    resolve_conflict()
-
-    # A tracked file whose name collides with a refname (eg. HEAD) must not
-    # make the merge-diff enumeration ambiguous.
-    with open('HEAD', 'w') as head_file:
-        head_file.write('x')
-    cmd_output('git', 'add', 'HEAD')
-
-    ret = set(git.get_conflicted_files())
-    assert ret == {'conflict_file', 'HEAD'}
-
-
 @pytest.mark.parametrize('refname', ('HEAD', 'MERGE_HEAD'))
-def test_get_conflicted_files_tracked_file_named_like_ref_param(
+def test_get_conflicted_files_tracked_file_named_like_ref(
         in_merge_conflict, refname,
 ):
     resolve_conflict()
 
+    # A tracked file whose name collides with a refname must not make the
+    # merge-diff enumeration ambiguous.
     with open(refname, 'w') as ref_file:
         ref_file.write('x')
     cmd_output('git', 'add', refname)
